issues.problem: Microsoft's operating income in fiscal 2024 was about $109.4 billion, not $88.5 billion. The figure given is even lower than net income ($88.1B), which can't be right for Microsoft. The text also has a typo ('$8 8.5').

data.summary: The analysis is mostly accurate, with one major error: operating income. Revenue of $245.1B, up 15.7% from $211.9B, is correct. So are net income of $88.1B, total assets of $512.2B and cash and cash equivalents of $18.3B. But operating income was about $109.4B, not $88.5B.
